Author: SloppyMods
Name: BossMod
Description: Bridge that registers as "BossMod" so addons which only recognise Veyn's BossMod work with BossMod Reborn. Provides the BossMod-only preset IPC endpoints and the /vbm and /vbmai command aliases. Requires BossMod Reborn enabled and the real BossMod disabled.
Punchline: Makes BossMod-only addons see BossMod Reborn.
